June, I couldn't set up the recurring post, so nothing is scheduled. Both times I tried to create the weekday 17:30 job, the scheduler refused because it needs gateway credentials I don't have.

I've replied in your thread in #strategic-pod to say so. I haven't posted a digest early.

Once an admin fixes the scheduler access, I'll set it to run weekdays at 17:30 Central, starting today. It will list only that day's new #strategic-pod messages. Until then, no 'Pod end of day' note will appear at 17:30.
